environment.description: Same provider binary deployed on EC2 in a private subnet (no IGW route). S3 access is exclusively through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy that includes a condition restricting requests: the policy allows s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject ONLY when aws:PrincipalOrgID matches 'o-abc123def4' AND the request includes a StringEquals condition on s3:prefix starting with 'states/' AND the source VPC endpoint ID matches vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. Additionally, the S3 bucket has a resource policy with an explicit Deny for any request where aws:sourceVpce is NOT vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. The EC2 instance security group allows inbound only from sg-0fedcba9876543210 (the CI runner SG) on port 8080. The IAM role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/TFStateProviderBoundary) that limits s3:* actions to resources matching arn:aws:s3:::acme-tf-state-prod/states/* with the condition that aws:ViaAWSService is false and aws:sourceVpce equals vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890.

config.instance_subnet: private (no IGW, no NAT for S3 traffic)
config.encryption_note: Application-layer crypto is weak but S3 access path is constrained to authorized VPC endpoint only
